summary.zh: 本次更新强化了设置、会话记录与持久化可靠性：统一了提供商与模型状态，修复了 Windows 下的文件写入问题，并确保技能徽章在历史与重试中不丢失。
summary.en: This release strengthens settings, session records, and persistence reliability: unified provider and model state, fixed file-write issues on Windows, and ensured skill badges are preserved across history and retries.

title.zh: 统一提供商与模型状态管理
title.en: Unify provider and model state management

summary.zh: 修复了设置窗口中提供商与模型状态不一致的问题，删除提供商后界面与运行状态能正确收敛，且失败的删除不会让卡片消失。
summary.en: Fixed inconsistencies between provider and model state in Settings; deleting a provider now correctly converges the interface and running state, and failed deletes keep the card visible.

details.zh: 左侧导航栏改为基于持久化提供商目录与页面草稿，不再依赖本地选择历史。
details.en: The left rail now derives from the persisted provider catalog plus page drafts instead of local selection history.

details.zh: 设置窗口共享一个运行时模型目录，所有辅助选择器同步订阅；主窗口通过现有 IPC 与同窗口事件广播模型变更，无需手动重新拉取。
details.en: Settings window owns a shared runtime model directory that all auxiliary selectors subscribe to; main window re-broadcasts changes over existing IPC and same-window events, so mounted modals reload automatically.

details.zh: 异步写入凭据后等待完成再刷新模型，且串行化刷新，避免旧快照覆盖新状态；写入路径拒绝 HTTP 2xx 加 JSON 错误的情况。
details.en: Wait for async runtime credential writes before refreshing models and serialize refreshes so stale snapshots can't overwrite newer ones; HTTP 2xx with JSON errors is rejected on write paths.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 技能徽章在历史与重试中保持显示
title.en: Skill badges persist across history and retries

summary.zh: 修复了会话显示记录未保存技能列表的问题，现在历史回放与重试/恢复路径都会正确还原技能徽章，子会话也能读取。
summary.en: Fixed display records not saving skills; history projection and retry/restore paths now correctly restore skill badges, and child sessions can read them too.

details.zh: 显示记录在写入时携带技能列表，历史投影在用户消息上恢复。
details.en: Display records carry the skill list through the structured write guard, and the history projection restores it on user messages.

details.zh: 重试/恢复时重新提交会保留技能，分叉会话复制同一显示记录并读取修复后的投影。
details.en: Retry/restore keeps skills when re-submitting; forking copies the same display record so child sessions read skills via the fixed projection.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries

title.zh: 修复 Windows 下的临时文件重命名失败
title.en: Fix transient rename failures on Windows

summary.zh: 当杀毒软件或索引器短暂占用文件时，Windows 上重命名写入的临时文件可能失败；现在会自动重试并最终仍不会误报成功。
summary.en: When antivirus or indexer holds a transient handle, renaming the just-written temp file can fail on Windows; the app now retries and still won't falsely report success if it never recovers.

details.zh: 对 EPERM/EBUSY 错误最多重试 4 次，带退避；超过次数才抛出异常。
details.en: Retries up to 4 times with backoff on EPERM/EBUSY, then throws only if it never recovers.

sources.title: fix(secret-fs): retry transient EPERM rename on Windows

title.zh: 持久化模式更清晰，数据兼容性保持
title.en: Cleaner persistence schema with backward compatibility

summary.zh: 会话记录与技能字段的持久化结构已更新，全部为可选追加字段，现有数据无需迁移。
summary.en: Persistence structure updated for session records and skill fields, all additive optional fields; existing data requires no migration.

details.zh: 会话路由现在持久化可选的技能数组，数据时代码保持不变。
details.en: Session routes now persist an optional skills array; DATA_EPOCH stays 1.

sources.title: build(persistence): repin schema fingerprint for skill list fields
